content.text:
g++ \
    make

# Copy files from node image
# NOTE: node /usr/lib is intentionally NOT copied: it overwrites libapk.so with an incompatible version
# from a differently-pinned alpine tag and breaks apk in this php image.
COPY --from=node /usr/local/share /usr/local/share
COPY --from=node /usr/local/lib /usr/local/lib
COPY --from=node /usr/local/include /usr/local/include
COPY --from=node /usr/local/bin /usr/local/bin

# Install Composer manually
COPY --from=composer/composer:latest-bin /composer /usr/bin/composer

observation.command: cd /workspace && cp docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile /tmp/tooling.Dockerfile.orig && sed -i 's#^COPY --from=node /usr/lib /usr/lib#\# NOTE: node /usr/lib is intentionally NOT copied: it overwrites libapk.so with an incompatible version\n\# from a differently-pinned alpine tag and breaks apk in this php image.#' docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile && sed -n '48,60p' docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile
